title: UI风格#71 - Retro Diner 50s (复古餐厅50年代)
description: 创建第71种UI风格：复古餐厅50年代风格 - 50年代美国、Checkerboard、红皮座。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBS.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When color palette Then features red, white, chrome, teal, cream
Given Retro Diner 50s style When typography Then uses retro fonts: Pacifico, Rockabilly, or Lobster
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Pacifico (headers 3.5rem), Rock Salt (tagline 1rem), Lobster (chat header/button 1.6rem/1.2rem), Open Sans (body 0.95rem)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When layout Then checkered floors, neon signs, jukebox styling
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: checkerboard stripe background, chrome gradient borders, teal/red radial gradients, pink divider accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When UI elements Then chrome borders, neon glow, booth styling
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: chrome gradient borders, rounded 20-25px corners, pink/teal/diner-red accents, gradient button shadows, booth card hover rotate

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s UI When functional Then includes diner chat, burger agents, tip stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: order window chat, 4 diner agents (Burger/Fries/Shake/Cone) with Patties/Smash/Crispy/Golden/Thickshake/Creamy/Scoops/Melty stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s UI When copy Then uses 50s americana: 'Grease', 'Shake', 'Fries', 'Coke'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'GREASE. SHAKE. FRIES.', tagline 'Welcome to the 1950s!', button 'ORDER', greeting 'Step right up! What'll it be today, hon?', status 'Serving'/'Idle', nav 'Diner'/'Kitchen'/'Menu'/'Counter'
